summary: Sarah Shaw is a Buddhist studies scholar who studied at the University of Oxford under Richard Gombrich and Lance S. Cousins. In 2013, she was affiliated with Oxford's Faculty of Oriental Studies and Wolfson College, and was an honorary fellow at the Oxford Centre for Buddhist Studies.
Sarah Wells Brooks (1870–1941) was an Indology scholar. She studied at Radcliffe College in 1892 under Charles Rockwell Lanman.
Saraju Rath is an Indologist and linguist. She held posts at the International Institute for Asian Studies, attested in 2012 and 2022.

Sarasi Kumar Saraswati (1906–1983) worked in Indology, history, and archaeology. He studied under Sivaprasad Bhattacharyya and Jitendra Nath Banerjea, served as Librarian at The Asiatic Society in 1943, and held a post at the University of Calcutta.

Sarat Chandra Das (1849–1917) worked in Tibetology, Indology, and linguistics. Educated at Presidency University, Presidency College Chennai, and under Ugyen Gyatso and Sengchen Lobzang Palden Chöpel, he directed Bhutia Boarding School (1874) and translated Tibetan for the Bengal government (1881–1904).

Sarat Sarma is a scholar of philosophy and Buddhist studies. He earned a PhD at Manipur University, attested in 2006, where he studied under doctoral supervisor S. Shyamkishore Singh and teacher S. Lokendrajit Singh.

Sarath Piyananda Weerasekara is a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies. He pursued a Sinhala-medium PhD at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies under the supervision of Deshapriya Gunasena (G. A. Gamini), attested in 2026.

Saroj Kanta Kar works in philosophy and Buddhist studies. He held positions at GITAM University, MS University of Baroda, Nava Nalanda Mahavihara, the Indian Council of Philosophical Research, and Utkal University, where he became Associate Professor in 2022.

Saroja Bhate (b. 1942) is an Indologist and linguist. She served as Professor at Savitribai Phule Pune University (~1979–2002) and as Honorary Secretary at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute (~1999–2006).

Sarva Daman Singh is a scholar of Indology, history, and archaeology who studied under Arthur Llewellyn Basham. He served as Professor of History at the University of Queensland, where his affiliation is attested in 1958 and 1987.

Sarvepalli Gopal (1923–2002) was a historian. He studied at Madras Christian College, Presidency College Chennai, the University of Madras (~1940–1944), and Balliol College, Oxford (~1945–1951), later holding a post at Jawaharlal Nehru University (~1971–1983).

Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan (1888–1975) was a scholar of philosophy, Indology, and religion educated at Madras Christian College. He held professorships at the Universities of Mysore, Calcutta, and Oxford, served as Vice-Chancellor of Andhra and Banaras Hindu Universities, and was Chancellor of Delhi University.

Saswati Mutsuddy is an Indologist and Buddhist studies scholar. She earned her MA, MPhil, and PhD from the University of Calcutta, where she studied under Dipak Kumar Barua and joined the Department of Pali in 2001.

Sati Shankar Dutta Pandey works in Indology and philosophy. He completed his master's and PhD at Banaras Hindu University (1981–1990) and founded the Global Synergetic Foundation in 1992, serving as its Chief Functionary.

Satiranjan Sen worked in Sinology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Peking University, served as a Research Scholar and Junior Research Fellow at Visva-Bharati University, and founded Cheen Bharat Sanskriti.

Satish Chandra (1922–2017) was an Indologist and historian. He studied at the University of Allahabad (~1940–1948) and held academic posts at Aligarh Muslim University (~1953–1961) and the University of Rajasthan (~1961–1970).
Satish Chandra Garkoti is an Indologist. He earned his PhD at Kumaun University (1988–1992) and served as concurrent faculty at Jawaharlal Nehru University in 2008.

Satish Chandra Vidyabhusan (1870–1920) was an Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology scholar. He studied under Sarat Chandra Das and at the University of Calcutta, later serving as Principal of Sanskrit College (~1910–1920) and Joint Philological Secretary at The Asiatic Society.

Satish Kumar Tiwari is an Indologist and philosopher who earned his PhD from the University of Lucknow (2011–2017). He held assistant professor posts at Lucknow, Ganesh Dutt College, Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University, Mahendra Mahila College, and A.P.B. Government Post Graduate College.

Satkari Mookerjee (1896–1968) was an Indologist, philosopher, and Buddhist studies scholar. He served as Ashutosh Professor of Sanskrit at the University of Calcutta (~1937–1955) and became Director of Nava Nalanda Mahavihara in 1955.
